checks.observation: Theorems 1–2 provide general counting statements; sunflower hypotheses enter the degree and codegree caps used for 72,56,53. Theorem 4 inherits Theorem 3 hypotheses without requiring its conclusion, so the presentation introduces no circular support argument. Theorem 5 uses the support theorem to relabel an exact 28-member subfamily and leaves nonexistence unresolved. The abstract and conclusion preserve that distinction, acknowledge external I(27), and limit formal assurance to project-source rebuilding with cached packages.
